text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A fierce battle on the straight course!! 
Every Umamusume is launching into their 
final spurt!!

text_block_list.name: Ruck & Eye
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAH!!!! —YAAAAAAAH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Ngh...! I thought I could break away...! 
Ai-san's pressure is unbelievable...!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Across the line!! In first place is—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(My finish was sloppy...! I've got a lot 
to reflect on, but the biggest thing is—)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I lost...! And I was so sure I was going 
to win...!!"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(—I misjudged Ai-san's true strength. That 
was where the gears went completely out of 
order.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(I never imagined she had that kind of 
speed...! If her luck was on her side, 
that kind of—)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: âLala!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Ai-san—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...That was a frustrating result for both 
of us, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, that's true.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Still, I still have the Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Lala! Race against me once more there! And 
next time, let's settle the score for 
good!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
This time for sure, without a doubt, I'm 
going to win the championship!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(...Ai-san was incredible today, just 
based on her running alone.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(On top of that, this incredible presence 
that makes you certain she'll be even 
stronger next time...! I really can't let 
my guard down. But――)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Just what I was hopin' for.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
The next Oaks is where I'll prove once and 
for all that I'm the queen.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: You'd better be ready.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yes...! I'm looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Lucky Lilac's Oka Sho ended in a 
frustratingly close result—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The next day.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Eye's performance at the Oka Sho was 
beyond anything I had imagined...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
That speed and pressure... Even 
remembering it now makes me shiver.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...I really underestimated Ai-san. I 
definitely need to reflect on that...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye's running far surpassed all 
prior predictions.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her speed, in particular, conceals an 
astounding potential. We'll need to stay 
on high alert for the Oaks...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —I will never, ever misjudge them again.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Let's leave nothing to chance and win this 
time. I'll be counting on your guidance.
choice_data_list:
Let's go claim it—the glory of the 
Oaks...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Toward the next decisive battle, the 
Yushun Himba (Oaks). This time, the tiara 
will be in her grasp—
